lines.say: This is the control room, live on Base Sepolia. Three machines, and a fifty thousand dollar treasury. C N C oh seven is the one degrading — zone B, with fifty-eight hours before it must be stopped.
lines.caption:
The control room, live on Base Sepolia.
CNC-07 is degrading: Zone B, 58 hours left.

lines.beat: running the agent on the routine lane
lines.say: Now the agent runs. It reads the trend, checks the shelf and what is already on order, and prices the part against the two suppliers the plant has vetted. This is the model deciding, not a replay. Zero in stock, a supplier who can deliver inside the window — and one hundred and eighty dollars is under the ceiling, so it signs and funds it alone.
lines.caption:
The agent reads the trend, the shelf, what is on order,
and prices it against vetted suppliers.
$180 is under the ceiling — it funds it alone.

lines.beat: advancing the run hour into Zone C
lines.say: Advance the run hour, and the machine crosses into zone C.
lines.caption: Advance the run hour. The machine crosses into Zone C.

lines.beat: now the bearing will not save it — the agent escalates
lines.say: A bearing no longer saves it. By zone C the shaft is already scored, so the agent escalates to the spindle cartridge — a different part, and a very different number.
lines.caption:
By Zone C a bearing no longer saves it.
The agent escalates to the spindle.

lines.beat: it stops, because $4,000 is over the ceiling
lines.say: Four thousand dollars is over the ceiling. It stops. The order exists, and no money has moved.
lines.caption:
$4,000 is over the ceiling. It stops.
The order exists. No money moved.

lines.say: A human approves it, from a separate key. That approval bypasses the cap — because the cap bounds the agent, not the plant.
lines.caption:
A human approves, from a separate key.
The cap bounds the agent, not the plant.

lines.say: Back to the bearing. The supplier despatches, committing to the waybill with their own key, and goods-in confirms against it. Only then does escrow release.
lines.caption:
The supplier commits a waybill with their own key.
Escrow releases only against a match.

lines.beat: issuing the part to the machine
lines.say: The part is issued to the machine. It leaves the store, which is what lets the agent order the next one.
lines.caption:
The part leaves the store — which is what lets
the agent order the next one.

lines.say: Every figure on this screen is a transaction you can look up on a block explorer. The agent committed one hundred and eighty dollars on its own, and stopped at four thousand.
lines.caption:
Every figure is a transaction you can look up.
$180 committed alone. Stopped at $4,000.
